FIELD_ACCELERATION_RMS_DESC: Amplitude of vibration measurement, used to monitor changes in vibration amplitude and anomalies.
FIELD_ACCLERATION_ENVELOPE_DESC: Analyze vibration characteristics by extracting the envelope of high-frequency vibration signals.
FIELD_ACCLERATION_PEAK_DESC: Maximum acceleration value in vibration signals, helpful for monitoring extreme values.
FIELD_ATTITUDE_INDEX_DESC: Indicates axial tilt changes of the sensor.
FIELD_CREST_FACTOR_DESC: Reflects the extreme degree of peaks in vibration waveforms, calculated as the ratio of peak value to RMS value.
FIELD_DEFECT_LEVEL_DESC: Determines the size of bolt cracks.
FIELD_DEFECT_LOCATION_DESC: Determines the location of bolt cracks (-1 means no defect).
FIELD_DISPLACEMENT_PEAK_TO_PEAK_DESC: Maximum variation range in displacement in vibration signals.
FIELD_DISPLACEMENT_RMS_DESC: Root mean square value of displacement in vibration signals, used to represent vibration intensity.
FIELD_FIRST_HARMONIC_DESC: Amplitude of the vibration component with a frequency equal to the fundamental frequency (primary vibration frequency).
FIELD_FREQUENCY_DESC: Vibration frequency of the monitoring equipment.
FIELD_HALF_HARMONIC_DESC: Amplitude of the vibration component with a frequency equal to half of the fundamental frequency.
FIELD_INCLINATION_DESC: Total tilt angle from the sensor's default posture.
FIELD_KURTOSIS_DESC: Describes the flatness of vibration signal waveforms, used to detect abnormal waveforms and nonlinear vibrations.
FIELD_KURTOSIS_NORM_DESC: Describes the flatness of vibration signal waveforms, used to detect abnormal waveforms and nonlinear vibrations.
FIELD_LONG_TERM_CORROSION_RATE_DESC: Corrosion rate calculated based on set time.
FIELD_MARGIN_FACTOR_DESC: Used to assess the amplitude margin of vibration signals, calculated as the ratio of peak acceleration to RMS value.
FIELD_MOTION_DESC: Indicates the positional change of the sensor relative to the anchor point.
FIELD_PPECTRUM_RMS_DESC: RMS value of vibration signals in the frequency domain, used to measure the amplitude and energy distribution of vibration signals.
FIELD_PULSE_FACTOR_DESC: Ratio of peak acceleration to rectified average value (average of absolute values), used to assess pulse vibration characteristics.
FIELD_RPM_DESC: Rotational speed of the measured device.
FIELD_SECOND_HARMONIC_DESC: Amplitude of the vibration component with a frequency equal to twice the fundamental frequency.
FIELD_SHORT_TERM_CORROSION_RATE_DESC: Corrosion rate calculated based on set time.
FIELD_SIGNAL_QUALITY_DESC: Ultrasonic signal quality, used to detect installation quality.
FIELD_SIGNAL_STRENGTH_DESC: Ultrasonic signal strength, used to detect installation quality.
FIELD_SKWENESS_DESC: Detects the distribution skewness of vibration signals to identify asymmetric vibration and abnormal conditions.
FIELD_SKWENESS_NORM_DESC: Detects the distribution skewness of vibration signals to identify asymmetric vibration and abnormal conditions.
FIELD_SPECTRUM_MEAN_DESC: Mean value of frequency-domain variables, providing the central position information of vibration signals in the frequency domain.
FIELD_SPECTRUM_VARIANCE_DESC: Represents the distribution of vibration signals in the frequency domain, used to evaluate spectral stability.
FIELD_STRESS_DESC: Axial stress of the bolt, representing axial tensile force per unit area.
FIELD_THIRD_HARMONIC_DESC: Amplitude of the vibration component with a frequency three times the fundamental frequency (primary vibration frequency).
FIELD_VARIANCE_DESC: Describes the variation degree of vibration signals in the time domain, reflecting signal fluctuation.
FIELD_VELOCITY_RMS_DESC: Root mean square value of vibration velocity, used to represent vibration intensity.

SETTING_AUTO_GAIN_IS_ENABLED_DESC: When enabled, the sensor automatically adjusts gain based on the measured acceleration level; when disabled, the range must be selected manually.

SETTING_AXIS_XY_RANGE_DESC: Acceleration range for X and Y axes during feature data acquisition.

SETTING_AXIS_Z_SAMPLING_NUMBER_DESC: Number of Z axis data points acquired per sampling.

SETTING_AXIS_Z_WAVEFORM_SAMPLING_TIME_DE: Sampling duration for Z axis waveform data acquisition.
SETTING_CLAMPED_LENGTH_DESC: Length of the bolt section subjected to tensile force.
SETTING_CORROSION_RATE_LONG_DESC: Calculation period for long-term corrosion rate.
SETTING_CORROSION_RATE_SHORT_DESC: Calculation period for short-term corrosion rate.
SETTING_DATA_AXIS_DESC: Specifies the axis used for waveform data acquisition.
SETTING_DISP_MODE_DESC: Select low-frequency mode when vibration frequency ≤ 200 Hz; otherwise, select high-frequency mode.

SETTING_DISPLACEMENT_CALCULATION_IS_ENAB: When enabled, the sensor reports displacement peak-to-peak values.
SETTING_DYNAMIC_MODE_FREQUENCY_DESC: Number of data points per second for dynamic data.
SETTING_DYNAMIC_MODE_SAMPLING_TIME_DESC: Duration of each dynamic data acquisition.
SETTING_ELASTIC_MODULUS_DESC: Elastic modulus of the measured object.

SETTING_GATEWAY_ADDRESS_DESC: IP gateway address in static IP mode.

SETTING_IP_MODE_DESC: IP address mode of the Ethernet interface.
SETTING_LENGTH_ROD_DESC: Length of the sensor waveguide rod.
SETTING_NTP_ADDRESS_DESC: Address or domain name of the NTP server.
SETTING_NTP_IS_ENABLED_DESC: If enabled, the gateway synchronizes time with the NTP server.
SETTING_PRELOAD_COEF_DESC: Calibration coefficient for bolt preload based on actual calibration results.
SETTING_RANGE_DESC: Acceleration range for feature data acquisition.
SETTING_SAMPLING_FREQUNECY_DESC: Number of data points acquired per second for feature data.

SETTING_SAMPLING_NUMBER_DESC: Number of data points acquired per sampling.
SETTING_SAMPLING_OFFSET_DESC: Delay duration after the acquisition period is reached.
SETTING_SAMPLING_PERIOD_DESC: Time interval between each data acquisition in periodic sampling.

SETTING_SECTIONAL_AREA_DESC: The axial force section area of the bolt.
SETTING_SUBNET_MASK_DESC: Subnet mask in static IP mode.

SETTING_VIBRATION_BASE_FREQUENCY_DESC: Used to set the vibration frequency of the spindle. If set to 0, the sensor will measure the vibration frequency internally.
SETTING_WAVE_SPEED_DESC: The propagation speed of ultrasonic longitudinal waves in the measured object.
SETTING_WAVEFORM_RANGE_DESC: Acceleration range corresponding to waveform data acquisition.

SETTING_WAVEFORM_SAMPLING_OFFSET_DESC: Delay in data acquisition after the waveform data acquisition period is reached.
SETTING_WAVEFORM_SAMPLING_PERIOD_DESC: Time interval between each waveform data acquisition in periodic sampling.
SETTING_WAVEFORM_SAMPLING_TIME_DESC: Sampling duration for waveform data acquisition.
